nodes.label: Render Free Plan Deployment
nodes.rationale: Sleeps after 15 min idle; photo analysis gives vision step 25 s timeout then proceeds without it.

nodes.label: data-resources Message Part
nodes.rationale: Answer streams first; sources, videos and products arrive after as one part rendered below and persisted. Product names/prices come from DB, not the model.

nodes.label: Qwen3-Embedding-8B (1024-d multilingual)
nodes.rationale: Chosen after measuring Bangla to English matching; text-embedding-3-small could not separate related from unrelated passages.

nodes.norm_label: rag ingest pipeline (scripts/ingest-books.mjs, npm run rag:ingest)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent: re-running replaces each document's passages in one transaction; repo stores only metadata and downloads text at run time for licensing reasons.

nodes.norm_label: fao manuals (a garden for everyone 2005; diversifying rural incomes through home gardens 2004)

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation
nodes.rationale: No RAG -> answers without citations; no YouTube key -> search card; slow designer model -> standard question bank.

nodes.label: Row-level Security (no policies)
nodes.rationale: RLS on with no policies so Supabase public REST API cannot read/write; only direct server DB connection can.

nodes.label: Two Databases, Two Jobs
nodes.rationale: App data in plain Postgres/PGlite; vector workload isolated and optional in Supabase pgvector.

nodes.norm_label: capacitor with next build static export (rejected)

nodes.label: Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap / PWABuilder)
nodes.rationale: Fastest path but requires Chrome and less native/offline control.

nodes.label: HMAC-signed Designer Render Prompts
nodes.rationale: Prevents client from injecting its own image prompt; signed with BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes vs training data; agents must read bundled docs before writing code. Block is regenerated by next dev.

nodes.label: Capacitor Shell (remote-URL mode)
nodes.rationale: Zero rewrite; site needs server routes, auth and secrets so static export is impossible; app updates on each website deploy; native plugins possible later.

nodes.label: Native Push Reminders (@capacitor/push-notifications + Firebase)
nodes.rationale: Strengthens app against Play's minimum functionality policy for thin website wrappers.

nodes.label: ChhadKrishi ML Service (FastAPI, CPU-only)
nodes.rationale: Sized for Render free plan (512 MB RAM, 0.1 CPU), ~275 MB peak; Whisper excluded because it needs ~2 GB RAM.

nodes.label: LLM Providers (AI Gateway, OpenRouter, Google, Groq)
nodes.norm_label: llm providers (ai gateway, openrouter, google, groq)

nodes.label: src/lib/ai/config.ts Provider-agnostic Model Selection
nodes.rationale: Picks first configured provider (AI Gateway, OpenRouter, Google) with per-task overrides and OpenRouter fallback chains.

nodes.label: Server-only AI
nodes.rationale: All model, embedding and YouTube calls run in route handlers so keys never reach the browser; client sees only stable error codes like AI_RATE_LIMITED.

nodes.label: OpenCV Sharpness/Exposure and Leaf-colour Measurements
nodes.rationale: Numbers are evidence passed to the vision LLM, not a diagnosis; lab 99% accuracy figures (PlantVillage) do not hold in the field.

nodes.label: YOLOv8s Leaf Detector (foduucom, ONNX)
nodes.rationale: Used only to locate leaves; crop-name labels ignored as often wrong on real photos. Weights likely AGPL-3.0 under Ultralytics.
